name: Egyptian cast-glass amulet
summary: This New Kingdom Egyptian heart amulet was cast in glass in a mold and inlaid with bone, made for the funerary amulet tradition.
description: A New Kingdom heart amulet of mold-cast glass with a bone inlay, used in an Egyptian funerary context.
